response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, n*100.0/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: A missing status means powerstatus IS NULL, which GROUP BY keeps as its own group. Empty strings are treated as ordinary status values.

The average share across statuses is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares, with the NULL group counted as one status. Because shares sum to 100, this equals 100 divided by the number of groups.
Share is the status's telescope count divided by the total number of rows in telescopes, times 100.
